notes: «- المعنى -» and «- يعني ابن حكيم -» are editor glosses: left out.

Second scene: Said goes to Ibn Abbas, who says «صدق» and explains «كل شىء يصنع من مدر». This is a second saying in a narrated encounter with its own exchange; needs_ruling, not written as a route here.
The first route ends at the Companion Ibn Umar, who is the one heard («سمعت عبد الله بن عمر يقول»).
